# DialogManager

**Class:** `UltraCanvasDialogManager` · **Group:** [Application, windows and dialogs](../Groups/Application-Windows-And-Dialogs.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasModalDialog.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasModalDialog.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasModalDialog.h"`

## What it is for

The one-line way to show a message, question, warning, error, confirmation or input dialog; the answer arrives in a callback.

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `ShowMessage()` | `static void ShowMessage(const std::string& message, const std::string& title, DialogType type, DialogButtons buttons, std::function<void(DialogResult)> onResult = nullptr, UltraCanvasWindowBase* parent = nullptr)` | These methods show dialogs non-blocking and deliver results via callbacks. |
| `ShowInformation()` | `static void ShowInformation(const std::string& message, const std::string& title, std::function<void(DialogResult)> onResult = nullptr, UltraCanvasWindowBase* parent = nullptr)` | Takes a callback. |
| `ShowQuestion()` | `static void ShowQuestion(const std::string& message, const std::string& title, std::function<void(DialogResult)> onResult, UltraCanvasWindowBase* parent = nullptr)` | Takes a callback. |
| `ShowWarning()` | `static void ShowWarning(const std::string& message, const std::string& title, std::function<void(DialogResult)> onResult = nullptr, UltraCanvasWindowBase* parent = nullptr)` | Takes a callback. |
| `ShowError()` | `static void ShowError(const std::string& message, const std::string& title, std::function<void(DialogResult)> onResult = nullptr, UltraCanvasWindowBase* parent = nullptr)` | Takes a callback. |
| `ShowConfirmation()` | `static void ShowConfirmation(const std::string& message, const std::string& title, std::function<void(bool confirmed)> onResult, UltraCanvasWindowBase* parent = nullptr)` | Takes a callback. |
| `ShowInputDialog()` | `static void ShowInputDialog(const std::string& prompt, const std::string& title, const std::string& defaultValue, InputType type, std::function<void(DialogResult, const std::string&)> onResult, UltraCanvasWindowBase* parent = nullptr)` | Takes a callback. |
| `ShowInputDialog()` | `static void ShowInputDialog(const InputDialogConfig& config, std::function<void(DialogResult, const std::string&)> onResult, UltraCanvasWindowBase* parent = nullptr)` | The same from a whole config (the prompt is its inputLabel) - for what the short form cannot say, such as iconAboveInput. With native dialogs on, the native one is shown (title, prompt, default value, type) and the rest of the config is not. |
| `ShowDialog()` | `static void ShowDialog(std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasModalDialog> dialog, std::function<void(DialogResult)> onResult = nullptr, UltraCanvasWindowBase* parent = nullptr)` | Takes a callback. |

### struct `DialogConfig`

DialogConfig extends WindowConfig with dialog-specific properties

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `heading` | `std::string heading` | Dialog content A short line in bold above the message ("Save changes to “Chapter 3.md”?"), the message then says the rest. Empty: no heading, the message stands alone. The window's title stays the title bar's. |
| `message` | `std::string message` |  |
| `details` | `std::string details` |  |
| `dialogType` | `DialogType dialogType = DialogType::Information` |  |
| `buttons` | `DialogButtons buttons = DialogButtons::OK` | Buttons |
| `defaultButton` | `DialogButton defaultButton = DialogButton::OK` |  |
| `cancelButton` | `DialogButton cancelButton = DialogButton::Cancel` |  |
| `position` | `DialogPosition position = DialogPosition::CenterParent` | Dialog-specific positioning |
| `showIcon` | `bool showIcon = true` | The coloured square with the type letter (i / ! / X / ?) on the left of the message. Turn it off for a dialog whose content carries its own graphic — a progress ring, a chart, a preview — so that content is centred in the full width of the window instead of being pushed to the right of a badge that adds nothing. |
| `closeOnEscape` | `bool closeOnEscape = true` | Dialog behavior |
| `autoCloseTime` | `float autoCloseTime = 0.0f` | bool closeOnClickOutside = false; 0 = no auto close |
| `activateDefaultOnEnter` | `bool activateDefaultOnEnter = true` | Return/Enter activates defaultButton when the focused element does not consume the key itself (a focused button, a multiline text field). |
| `useButtonMnemonics` | `bool useButtonMnemonics = true` | Give every button a mnemonic letter, drawn underlined in its label. Alt+letter always activates it; a bare letter does too, but only while the dialog holds no editable text field that would swallow it. |
| `clearPendingInput` | `bool clearPendingInput = true` | Discard keys that were already held down when the dialog opened, and forget the keyboard state again when it closes. Without this a key still down from the action that opened the dialog dismisses it immediately, and the key that dismissed it leaks to the parent window. |

Methods: `GetSize`, `SetSize`

### struct `InputDialogConfig`

The dialog is `height` tall at least and grows with its prompt: a long one wraps at the dialog's width and the window is made as tall as the lines and the field need (up to most of the monitor, then it scrolls).

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `inputType` | `InputType inputType = InputType::Text` |  |
| `inputLabel` | `std::string inputLabel = "Input:"` | The prompt. With `message` set as well, `message` is the prompt and this is the caption directly above the field. |
| `inputPlaceholder` | `std::string inputPlaceholder` |  |
| `defaultValue` | `std::string defaultValue` |  |
| `validationPattern` | `std::string validationPattern` | Regex pattern |
| `validationMessage` | `std::string validationMessage = "Invalid input"` |  |
| `iconAboveInput` | `std::string iconAboveInput` | A picture centred above the field (its caption included), e.g. the lock of an Unlock dialog: a file path (SVG or bitmap), drawn as a mask in the dialog's text colour so it follows the theme. Empty: none. `iconAboveInputSize` is its width and height. |
| `iconAboveInputSize` | `float iconAboveInputSize = 48.0f` |  |
| `minLength` | `int minLength = 0` | Input constraints |
| `maxLength` | `int maxLength = 1000` |  |
| `minLines` | `int minLines = 1` | For multiline text |
| `maxLines` | `int maxLines = 10` | For multiline text |
| `required` | `bool required = false` |  |
| `validator` | `std::function<bool(const std::string&)> validator` |  |
| `onInputChanged` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onInputChanged` |  |
